description: This file defines the ShippingQuote class, which models a shipping quote including options, costs, and related status information within a sales management system.

classes.name: ShippingQuote
classes.description: A class representing shipping quotation details, including shipping options, costs, module code, and error states.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: getShippingOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: setShippingReturnCode
methods.description: Sets the return code indicating shipping status or errors.

methods.name: getShippingReturnCode
methods.description: Gets the return code indicating shipping status or errors.

methods.name: setFreeShipping
methods.description: Flag indicating whether shipping is free.

methods.name: setFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Sets the threshold amount for free shipping.

methods.name: getFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Gets the free shipping threshold amount.

methods.name: setHandlingFees
methods.description: Sets handling fees to be added to shipping costs.

methods.name: setApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Enables or disables tax application on shipping.

methods.name: isApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Checks if tax applies on shipping.

methods.name: getSelectedShippingOption
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected shipping option.

methods.name: getQuoteError
methods.description: Gets error message related to shipping quote.

methods.name: setQuoteError
methods.description: Sets error message related to shipping quote.
